goal: Establish the pure stat-signature policy, additive PostgreSQL snapshot/job schema and one fenced single-flight repository without activating a route, worker or frontend consumer.
userValue: The later async SimC worker can deduplicate, recover and publish verified stat snapshots without trusting clients, mixing revisions or blocking HTTP request threads.
nonGoals: No SimC worker or systemd unit
No DPS fields or raw SimC output
No Phase 4 Manifest or refresh change

mustChange: one pure revision-complete server-owned stat signature contract
one additive PostgreSQL migration for immutable verified snapshots, append-attempt jobs and bounded worker state
one repository for cache lookup, transactional single-flight, global and per-client limits, fenced claim, heartbeat, reclaim, completion, cooldown and bounded health
least privileges with no DELETE and no verified snapshot mutation
mustNotChange: Resolver, Profile or legacy stat endpoint behavior
evidenceRequired: red-to-green pure policy, repository and schema tests
concurrent single-flight and stale-token fencing fixtures
candidate database backup and atomic migration apply
direct PostgreSQL insert, reuse, claim, heartbeat, reclaim, immutable conflict, limit and health smoke
backend/full verification, Strict Harness, local CR, exact-head CI and post-merge schema parity

ownership.factOwner: server/gear_stat_snapshot.py owns pure signature and bounded result policy; server/gear_stat_snapshot_store.py owns all snapshot/job/worker SQL

engineeringHealth.reason: This introduces a new write-capable execution queue. Signature completeness, transaction boundaries, partial uniqueness, lease fencing, immutable publication, least privilege and bounded aggregates must be proven before any route or worker is allowed to consume it.

acceptanceEvidence: candidate PostgreSQL backup, migration, direct store smoke and post-merge schema parity

decisionLog.decision: Workers never execute stored profile text; they re-resolve and recompute the exact stat signature before SimC.
Verified snapshots are immutable, jobs are append-attempt operational state, and stale worker completion is blocked by lock-token fencing.
Phase 5 ships with one SimC child and no route/worker activation in Slice 5A.
